baseline.name: Scan rightward visibility for each person
baseline.approach: For each starting person, walk right while tracking the blocking horizon.
baseline.space: O(1) working state plus O(n) output

archived.name: Right-to-left monotonic stack
archived.space: O(n) working stack plus O(n) output

why: Shorter horizons that are popped cannot matter to future left-side observers, so repeated suffix scans are avoided.
quantitative_comparison: A naive scan can consider n(n-1)/2 observer/right-person pairs. The archive pushes each height once and pops it at most once, plus one surviving-barrier check per person. No timing ratio is derived.
tradeoffs: Uses extra linear stack storage and the distinct-height visibility model. Small inputs may not amortize allocation overhead; source hardware comments are not benchmarks.
evidence_basis: Static monotonic-stack amortized argument and stated scan baseline; no paired timing.
